cards.heading: Download Aadhaar
cards.description: Click here to download digitally signed and password protected electronic copy of the Aadhaar.

cards.heading: Retrieve Aadhaar number/EID/SID
cards.description: Click here to find out Aadhaar number, Enrolment ID (EID) or Service ID (SID).

cards.heading: Verify email / mobile
cards.description: Click here to verify mobile and email registered with the Aadhaar.

cards.heading: Report death of a family member
cards.description: Click here to report death of a Family Member for his/her Aadhaar deactivation.

cards.heading: Document update
cards.description: Click Here to upload your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) Documents.

cards.heading: VID generator
cards.description: Click here to generate 16 Digit Virtual ID(VID) linked to your Aadhaar.

cards.heading: Lock / Unlock Aadhaar
cards.description: Click to temporarily lock/unlock your Aadhaar. please Use This Service Carefully.

cards.heading: Bank seeding status
cards.description: Click here to find Bank Seeding Status.

cards.heading: Check Aadhar PVC Card order Status
cards.description: Click Here to check the status of your Aadhaar PVC Card ordered.

cards.heading: Check Enrolment Or Update Status
cards.description: Click Here to check the status of your Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Request.

cards.heading: Locate Enrolment Center
cards.description: click here to search And Locate Nearby Aadhaar Seva Kendra.

cards.heading: Book An Appointment
cards.description: Click here to book an appointment for Aadhaar Enrolment or Update.

cards.heading: check Aadhaar Validity
cards.description: click here to validate the status of the aadhaar.
